transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, August 12. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Why Messi didn't visit Kerala? Sports department tells govt in 'highly confidential manner'. Kerala's Sports Department has submitted a confidential inquiry report into the failed proposal to bring Lionel Messi and Argentina's football team to the state. The probe examined whether proper procedures and agreements were followed. While reports suggest serious findings, Sports Minister O J Janeesh withheld details. Former minister V Abdurahiman rejected allegations, saying the government suffered no financial loss. August 12 solar eclipse: Europe set for first total eclipse in 27 years. Europe will witness its first total solar eclipse in twenty-seven years on August twelfth. Millions across Iceland and northern Spain will experience this rare celestial event. Nasa will livestream the eclipse for viewers outside the path of totality. Americans will see a partial eclipse, while Canada also observes it. Cristiano Ronaldo marries longtime partner Georgina Rodríguez. Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are officially married after nearly a decade together. The couple held a private civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on August 11, 2026, and confirmed the news with a joint Instagram post showing their wedding rings. Their five children reportedly attended, while the wedding came exactly one year after Rodríguez announced their engagement. 'Pilot not in full control': What happened on Air India's Phuket-Delhi flight. NEW DELHI: Trouble mounted for the pilot-in-command (PIC) of last Tuesday's badly rattled Phuket-Delhi Air India flight after it emerged that he had failed the confirmatory dope test and was found to have consumed marijuana. 'CJP twisted CJI remark': SC seeks govt, CBI response on PIL. NEW DELHI: Three months after CJI Surya Kant's 'cockroach' remark sparked a storm and gave birth to Cockroach Janta Party that led a Gen Z protest against NEET-UG paper leak, Supreme Court Tuesday sought responses from govt and CBI on a PIL seeking action against those who commercially exploited the remark through clever editing of virtual court proceedings and draped it with a meaning that was never intended. Video shows catering truck used to secretly move Trump between planes amid Iran threat. A video has emerged showing the airport catering truck that was used to secretly move President Donald Trump between aircraft during a covert security operation in Turkey last month. Malaysia's Princess Ilyana marries British GT racer Chris Froggatt. Tengku Puteri Raja Tengku Puteri Ilyana Alia, daughter of Pahang Sultan Al-Sultan Abdullah, married British racing driver Christopher Lionel Froggatt in Kuala Lumpur on August 7. The ceremony was attended by members of the Pahang royal family and followed traditional Islamic wedding customs, including the presentation of 'mas kahwin', ring exchange and 'merenjis'. Yonkers uncovers buried river, creating 14,000 sq ft of aquatic habitat. In 2012, Yonkers, New York, completed a project to uncover a section of the Saw Mill River that had been buried beneath a downtown parking lot since the 1920s. The former Larkin Plaza was turned into a three-acre public park. Within six months, the restored river supported 14,000 square feet of new aquatic habitat and several species. Trump, Modi have 'very good' ties, will resolve Russian oil tariff row: US official. US President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi have a "very good working relationship" and will resolve differences over Washington's threatened tariffs on countries buying Russian oil, White House Trade Adviser Peter Navarro said on Tuesday. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees. Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings. 'Process can't be unending': SC wants SIR tribunals in Bengal to work faster. NEW DELHI: With nearly 34 lakh appeals pending adjudication before SIR appellate tribunals against deletion of voters' names in West Bengal, Supreme Court Tuesday decided to take stock of their performance and suggested they speed up their work, saying the process cannot be unending, even though it was unwilling to set a deadline for decision on appeals. Jaguar TCS Racing sets world record with 29 runners over 100km. Jaguar TCS Racing has marked the end of the Formula E GEN3 era in a unique way. Ahead of the London E-Prix, 29 runners from Jaguar TCS Racing and Tata Consultancy Services covered more than 100km across London to create a GPS drawing of the Jaguar I-TYPE 7. The effort helped the team set a Guinness World Record before its home season finale.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Comes To Standstill After Heavy Rain, Waterlogging Triggers Traffic Jams. Heavy rain brought the city to a standstill on Tuesday, with widespread waterlogging and traffic jams reported across major roads. MP Congress Plans Jail Bharo Stir Over 62 Lakh Cases Against Workers. Madhya Pradesh Congress president Jitu Patwari said the party will stage protests and launch a Jail Bharo movement over alleged government action against Congress workers. Bhopal Reels Under Rain As Waterlogging Exposes Drainage Woes. Continuous heavy rain over 48 hours has caused widespread waterlogging, disrupting life across several parts of the city. MP Government Puts Bhopal, Indore Master Plans On Hold, Explores Relief For Traders. The Madhya Pradesh government is reportedly keeping the Bhopal and Indore master plans on hold as both cities move towards metropolitan development. Various programmes on 'Har Ghar Tiranga' to be organised in Madhya Pradesh. Missing Indore Techie: Digital Trail, Personal Life Add Twists To Shivagange Mystery. The disappearance of Indore-based software professional Advait Upadhyaya near Shivagange Hill has taken new twists after police found AI searches about the cliff and survival after a fall. Bhopal-Indore drive to take 2.5 hours: MP plans rupees 4,000cr greenfield expressway. Over 500 rescued from flash floods as heavy rains lash Madhya Pradesh. Nag Panchami In MP's Ujjain: Nagchandreshwar Temple To Open For 24 Hours. Nag Panchami will be celebrated at Shri Mahakaleshwar Temple on August 17, with Nagchandreshwar Temple opening from midnight August 16 to midnight August 17. Call for Blogs NLIU, Bhopal's CCJC Blog Invites Submissions on Civil and Criminal Justice. Air India Express launches Bhopal flights to Delhi, Mumbai. Madhya Pradesh Uses rupees 30 Of Every Fresh rupees 100 Borrowed On Old Debt. rupees 1,757cr Bhopal-Vidisha four-lane project gets cabinet nod. Bhopal-Raipur Travel Time To Halve With rupees 15,000-Crore Road Projects. Dug-up roads, infra works create pit-falls in Bhopal. rupees 150cr Bhopal flyover comes off at several places, roads drown in potholes. Nursing scam: HC summons council registrar on Aug 13. MP plans tiger-for-elephant, rhino exchange with other states. Two Men Attacked By Stray Dogs In Ujjain; Residents Demand Civic Action. Two men were injured in separate stray dog attacks in Hatkeshwar Colony on Tuesday morning. Cong vows statewide stir on students' issues, targets govt after PAC meet.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Global Investors Favor Taiwan Over Korea Stocks After AI Selloff. Taiwanese stocks are gaining favor over South Korea's on steadier earnings prospects, as the two AI-bellwether markets look to recover from July's rout. Trump media firm posts $238 million loss in second quarter as crypto falls. The president's media company posted a massive loss in the second quarter and announced plans to ditch new business lines and refocus as a forum for users to post their views. Trump Media and Technology, the company behind the Truth Social platform, said Monday that it lost USD238 million in the three months through June as it branched into businesses unrelated to media, including crypto. That was more than 10 times the loss from a year earlier. The per share loss widened to 86 cents from 8 cents. Yen Inches Toward 160 Per Dollar, Raising Intervention Concerns. The yen edged closer toward a key level against the dollar, raising concerns over Japanese authorities stepping in again to prop up the currency. SBI plans to raise funds through five-year dollar bonds, with the final issue size hinging on its ability to compress the initial pricing guidance Chicago grains weaken in positioning ahead of USDA report. The exchange asked Sebi in July to put its February 2025 exit application on hold, but the regulator has yet to receive a formal proposal for its revival Colombia Coffee Exports Largely Halted After Deadly Earthquake. Colombian coffee exports are largely paused after a devastating earthquake disrupted operations at the nation's main port and triggered roadblocks along key highways, according to the head of a coffee exporters' group. Move will extend Vault Managers Regulations beyond EG rupees to ETFs, derivatives Gold edges lower as markets await key US inflation data. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS (UPDATE 8):PRECIOUS TCS and Google Cloud set up new Gemini Experience Center in Mexico City. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and Google Cloud have set up a new Gemini Experience Center (GEC) in Mexico City, TCS' second in Latin America and the ninth worldwide. Shiprocket raises rupees 727 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO launch on Wednesday. E-commerce platform Shiprocket has raised rupees 727.41 crore from anchor investors ahead of its IPO, scheduled for August 12, 2026. The company aims to raise rupees 1,617 crore to enhance marketing and technology, repay borrowings, and potentially pursue acquisitions, with fixed share prices of rupees 92-97. Larsen and Toubro to transfer its data center and cloud services biz to Vyoma. For an aggregate consideration of rupees 1,400 cr Landmark Cars net profit nearly doubles to rupees 14.5 crore in Q1; revenue rises 22 percent. Landmark Cars reported a consolidated net profit of rupees 14.5 crore for the quarter ended June, up 97.5 percent YoY. Revenue rose 22.47 percent to rupees 1,733 crore, with Mercedes-Benz contributing 38 percent . The stock saw a recovery with a 15.4 percent gain in June and 10.2 percent in July. Tembo Global Industries consolidated net profit rises 57.99 percent in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 21.86 percent to rupees 302.35 crore Welfare ministries see a bureaucratic revolving door. Social and welfare ministries have seen many secretary changes over five years. Sebi proposes wider FPI access to non-agri commodity derivatives. FPIs are currently allowed to trade only in non-agri commodity derivatives that are cash settled, such as crude oil and natural gas contracts. Ecos (India) Mobility and Hospitality consolidated net profit rises 9.33 percent in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 16.70 percent to rupees 211.37 crore Indigenous drones to be showcased at Pokhran event. Indigenous unmanned systems will be showcased for the Indian Air Force next month. IFCI Q1 Results: Revenue declines, profit improves sequentially to rupees 60 crore. IFCI's Q1FY27 results show a sequential rise in net profit to rupees 60.27 crore but a flat year-on-year comparison. Revenue fell 20 percent to rupees 358 crore, and concerns arise as its Capital Risk Adequacy Ratio remains at negative 17.58 percent , below regulatory requirements. SC/ST atrocity compensation may get 40 percent boost. The government plans a substantial compensation hike for atrocity victims under the SC/ST Act. Apple shares fall amid confusion over 2027 'all-glass' iPhone plans; company clarifies, 'design didn't hold up,' but. Apple is still pursuing a glass-focused design for the iPhone's 20th anniversary, countering an analyst's claim of cancellation. Large-cap funds saw outflows of rupees 1,321 crore in July, the first monthly outflow in nearly three years, according to data from the Association of Mutual Funds of India. By contrast, investors pumped rupees 7,767 crore into small-cap funds during the month, while mid-cap funds saw inflows of rupees 6,192 crore. transcript.title: Across India
transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. Yashwant Varma cash probe report to be tabled in Lok Sabha today. NEW DELHI: The report of an inquiry committee, which probed into the allegations of financial irregularities against Allahabad HC Judge Yashwant Varma, will be tabled in Lok Sabha Wednesday. Shield people from unlawful digital content, SC tells govt. NEW DELHI: Supreme Court on Tuesday asked the Union ministries of home affairs and electronics and information technology to take urgent steps to create a URL-specific and judicially supervised emergency mechanism to protect citizens from grave unlawful digital content. NEW DELHI: India continues to examine the implications of the Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye security pact for its own security as well as regional peace and stability, said ministry of external affairs. Celebrate 'Har Ghar Tiranga' drive, PM Modi calls on every household.
